species.summary: Pulchriphyllium bioculatum, or Gray's leaf insect, is a leaf insect of the family Phylliidae native to tropical Asia as well as Madagascar, Mauritius and the Seychelles. It was first described by George Robert Gray in 1832, which was his first phasmid he discovered.
Rhombodera megaera is a species of praying mantises in the family Mantidae, found in China and Thailand.

Saletara liberia is a butterfly of the family Pieridae. It is found in Indonesia, the Philippines, Peninsular Malaysia and various islands in the region. Subspecies S. l. distanti is known by the common name Malaysian albatross.
Tectus fenestratus, common name the fenestrate top shell or the latticed top shell, is a species of sea snail, a marine gastropod mollusk in the family Tegulidae.
Terastia egialealis is a moth in the Crambidae family, Spilomelinae subfamily. It is found in India, China, Nepal, Thailand, West Malaysia, Sumatra, Java, Borneo, and Sulawesi.
Tonna allium, common name the costate tun, is a species of large sea snail, a marine gastropod mollusk in the family Tonnidae, the tun shells.
Tubuca rosea, also known by its common name rose fiddler crab, is a species of crab from the genus Tubuca.
Vanessa samani is a butterfly of the Nymphalidae family found on Sumatra, where it has been recorded from Mount Kerinci and the Karo Mountains.
Zeuxidia doubledayi is a large butterfly that belongs to the Morphinae group of the family Nymphalidae. It was described by John Obadiah Westwood in 1851. It is found in the Indomalayan realm.
Agathia succedanea is a species of moth of the family Geometridae. It is found on Borneo and Sumatra.
Agathodes modicalis is a moth in the family Crambidae. It was described by Achille Guenée in 1854. It is found in India, Indonesia (Java, Sumatra) and in South Africa (KwaZulu-Natal).
Amantis reticulata is a species of praying mantis found in Myanmar, Malaysia, Sumatra, Java, Borneo, and Palawan.
Anoplophora medenbachii (often misspelled medembachi) is a species of beetles in the family Cerambycidae. It is distributed in Southeast Asia (Borneo, Sumatra, Malaysia, Thailand).
Apalacris varicornis is a species of grasshopper in the family Acrididae. It is found in Indomalaya and has been recorded as a minor agricultural pest in Thailand and Malaysia.

Arhopala athada, the vinous oakblue is a species of butterfly belonging to the lycaenid family described by Otto Staudinger in 1889. It is found in Southeast Asia - Singapore, Peninsular Malaya, Sumatra, Borneo, Bangka, Bawean (A. a. athada), Assam, Burma, Mergui, Thailand (A. a.

Brana is a monotypic moth genus of the family Noctuidae. Its only species, Brana calopasa, is found in Sri Lanka and Australia. Both the genus and species were described by Francis Walker, the genus in 1858 and the species in 1859. It It is a serious pest on Berrya cordifolia (Trincomalee wood).
Britomartis cleoboides, the azure royal, is a butterfly in the family Lycaenidae. It is found from Sikkim to Thailand and from Peninsular Malaysia to Java.
Casmaria erinaceus, common name : the common bonnet, is a species of large sea snail, a marine gastropod mollusk in the family Cassidae, the helmet snails and bonnet snails.
Chersonesia peraka is an Indomalayan butterfly of the family Nymphalidae (Cyrestinae). It is found in the Indomalayan realm from Burma to Malaysia and on to Java, Bali, Borneo, Sumatra and Nias.

Choaspes subcaudata, commonly known as the blue awlking, is a species of butterfly belonging to the family Hesperiidae. It is found in Asia, Malaysia and Borneo. The species was first described by Baron Cajetan von Felder and Rudolf Felder in 1867.
Chrysaeglia magnifica is a moth in the Erebidae family, Arctiinae subfamily (formerly treated as Arctiidae family). It is found in Nepal, Sikkim, Borneo, Sulawesi and Taiwan.
Crimora lutea is a species of sea slug, a nudibranch, a shell-less marine gastropod mollusc in the family Polyceridae.
Curetis saronis, the Burmese sunbeam or Saronis sunbeam, is a species of butterfly belong to the lycaenid family. It is found in Asia.
Cyclidia javana is a moth in the Drepanidae family. It was described by Per Olof Christopher Aurivillius in 1894. It is found on Java and Borneo. The habitat consists of lowland forests.

Cydalima laticostalis is a moth in the Crambidae family. It was described by Guenée in 1854. It is found from India, Sri Lanka, Burma and Malaysia to the New Hebrides. It is also found in Australia, where it has been recorded from tropical Queensland.

Earias vittella, an Asian "spotted bollworm", is a moth species in the family Nolidae. The species was first described by Johan Christian Fabricius in 1794. Most records are from Asia, Australia and certain Pacific islands.

Ecliptopera rectilinea is a species of moth of the family Geometridae. It is found in the north-eastern parts of the Himalaya, Taiwan, northern Thailand, Peninsular Malaysia, Borneo, Bali, Sumbawa and Sulawesi.
Epicedia wrayi is a species of beetle in the family Cerambycidae and the subfamily of Lamiinae. It was described by Waterhouse in 1887. It is known from Malaysia.

species.nameEn: Oriental Orange Banded Green Geometer Moth
species.summary: The Oriental orange-banded green moth, (Eucyclodes gavissima), is a species of moth of the family Geometridae. It is found in the Indian subregion, Sri Lanka, Bhutan, western China, Taiwan, Sumatra and Borneo.

Eugoa aequalis is a moth of the family Erebidae first described by Francis Walker in 1858. It is found on Borneo, Peninsular Malaysia and Sumatra. The habitat consists of lowland areas, where it is found in various forest types, including heath, coastal and secondary forests.
Euploea modesta is a butterfly in the Nymphalidae family. It was described by Arthur Gardiner Butler in 1866. It is found in the Indomalayan realm and the Australasian realm.
Eurema nicevillei, the Malayan grass yellow, is a butterfly in the family Pieridae. It is found in Thailand, southern Burma, Peninsular Malaysia, Borneo, and Sumatra.

Euscyrtus concinnus, sometimes called long horned cricket, is a species of cricket found in South and Southeast Asia, including Sri Lanka, India, Bangladesh, Indonesia (Sumatra, Java, Borneo, Sulawesi), Thailand, and Vietnam.
Euselates cineracea is a species of beetle belonging to the family Scarabaeidae. This species occurs in Thailand, Malaysia, Java and Sumatra.
Euthalia alpheda is an Indomalayan butterfly of the Nymphalidae family (Limenitidinae).
Ganisa similis is a moth in the Eupterotidae family. It is found from the Himalayas to western China and Sundaland. The habitat consists of lowland and lower montane forests.
Gasteracantha sturi, commonly known as the blunt-spined kite spider, is a species of spider belonging to the family Araneidae. It is found in Southeast Asia, from Laos to the Moluccas.
Glenea camilla is a species of beetle in the family Cerambycidae. It was described by Francis Polkinghorne Pascoe in 1867.

Glenea celia is a species of beetle in the family Cerambycidae. It was described by Francis Polkinghorne Pascoe in 1888. It is known from Sumatra, Java, Borneo and Malaysia. It contains the varietas Glenea celia var. bipuncticollis.
Glenea funerula is a species of beetle in the family Cerambycidae. It was described by James Thomson in 1857. It is known from Sumatra, India, Malaysia, and Java.
Graphium agetes, the fourbar swordtail, is a widespread species of swallowtail butterfly found in tropical Asia. It is common and not threatened.

Graphium megarus, the spotted zebra, is a species of swallowtail butterfly found in Southeast Asia. It is common and not considered to be threatened; however, the nominate subspeciesis protected by law in India.
Graphium ramaceus, the Pendlebury's zebra, is a species of butterfly in the family Papilionidae (swallowtails). It is found in parts of the Indomalaya ecozone.

Haaniella gintingi is a stick insect species from Sumatra. It is a typical representative of the subfamily Heteropteryginae. The occasionally used common name Ginting's Haaniella refers to the species name.

Pacet gunung (Haemadipsa zeylanica) (bahasa Inggris: mountain leech) adalah spesies pacet pengisap darah yang ditemukan di Asia Tenggara dan Asia Timur. Sub-spesies pacet ini juga ditemukan di area pegunungan di Jepang, Haemadipsa zeylanica japonica.
Halgerda tessellata is a species of sea slug, a dorid nudibranch, shell-less marine gastropod mollusks in the family Discodorididae.
Hasora vitta, the plain banded awl, is a butterfly belonging to the family Hesperiidae which is found in India and parts of Southeast Asia.
Herochroma flavibasalis is a moth of the family Geometridae first described by William Warren in 1894. It is found in Sundaland. The habitat consists of lowland and lower montane forests.
Hierodula rufomaculata is a species of praying mantis in the family Mantidae.
Horithyatira decorata is a moth in the Drepanidae family. It is found from the north-eastern Himalaya and Nepal to southern China and Taiwan.

Hypocala deflorata is a moth of the Erebidae family. It is widespread from India, Sri Lanka to Africa and to Australia and many Pacific islands. Records include China, Borneo, Queensland, Vanuatu, New Caledonia, Rotuma, Fiji, Samoa, Hawaii, Norfolk Island and New Zealand.

Idea hypermnestra is a large butterfly that belongs to the danaid group of the family Nymphalidae. It was described by John Obadiah Westwood in 1848. It is found in the Indomalayan realm. It is found in Thailand and Malaysia.
Ixias pyrene, the yellow orange tip, is a small butterfly of the family Pieridae, that is, the yellows and whites, which is found in India and Southeast Asia.
Laringa castelnaui is a species of nymphalid butterfly found in Asia.
Leucoblepsis neoma is a moth in the family Drepanidae. It was described by Charles Swinhoe in 1905. It is found in Singapore and on Peninsular Malaysia, Sumatra and Borneo.

Lophophelma erionoma is a moth of the family Geometridae. It is found in China (Hunan, Guangxi, Zhejiang, Fujian, Jiangxi, Hainan, Sichuan), the north-eastern Himalaya and Sundaland. The habitat consists of lower montane and upper montane forests.

Microblepsis leucosticta is a moth in the Drepanidae family. It was described by Hampson in 1895. It is found in the north-eastern Himalayas, southern China and on Peninsular Malaysia, Sumatra and Borneo.

Myagrus vinosus is a species of beetle in the family Cerambycidae. It was described by Francis Polkinghorne Pascoe in 1866, originally under the genus Pharsalia. It is known from Borneo, the Philippines, Malaysia and Sumatra. It feeds on Ficus elastica.
Notarcha quaternalis is a species of moth of the Crambidae family. It can be found throughout subtropical Africa including many islands of the Indian Ocean.
Notocochlis gualteriana, common name the comma necklace shell, is a species of predatory sea snail, a marine gastropod mollusk in the family Naticidae, the moon snails.
Olenecamptus optatus is a species of beetle in the family Cerambycidae. It was described by Pascoe in 1866. It is known from Thailand, Singapore, Malaysia, Sumatra, Vietnam.

Papilio (Chilasa) paradoxa, the great blue mime, is a swallowtail butterfly found in India and parts of South-East Asia. The butterfly belongs to the mime subgenus, Chilasa, of the genus Papilio (black-bodied swallowtails). It is an excellent mimic of different species of Euploea (sub-family Danainae).
Paratectonatica tigrina, common name tiger moon snail, is a species of predatory sea snail, a marine gastropod mollusk in the family Naticidae, the moon snails.
Appias aegis, the forest white, is a butterfly in the family Pieridae. It is found in south-east Asia.
Phyllodes staudingeri is a moth in the family Erebidae first described by Georg Semper in 1901. It is found in Sumatra, Borneo, Java, the Philippines and New Guinea.
Platydoris formosa is a species of sea slug, a dorid nudibranch, shell-less marine opisthobranch gastropod mollusks in the family Discodorididae.
Polyura jalysus is a butterfly in the Nymphalidae family. It was described by Cajetan Felder and Rudolf Felder in 1867. It is found in the Indomalayan realm.
Problepsis achlyobathra is a species of moth of the family Geometridae. It is found in Sumatra, Peninsular Malaysia, Borneo, Java and Sulawesi.
Risoba prominens is a species of moth of the family Nolidae first described by Frederic Moore in 1881. It is found in India, Sri Lanka, Taiwan, Japan, Vietnam and Sundaland.
Risoba vialis is a species of moth of the Nolidae family. It is found in India, Philippines, Sulawesi and Sundaland.
Sipalinus gigas is a species of beetles belonging to the family Curculionidae.
Speiredonia sandokana is a species of moth of the Erebidae family. It is found on the Peninsular Malaysia, Sumatra and Borneo.
Spilarctia denigrata is a moth in the family Erebidae. It was described by Thomas in 1993. It is found on Sumatra in Indonesia.
Stilbum cyanurum, the large cuckoo wasp, is a species of cuckoo wasps (insects in the family Chrysididae)....
Sypnoides pannosa is a species of moth in the family Erebidae that was first described by Frederic Moore in 1882. It is found in India, the Himalayas, Borneo, Sumatra, Thailand and Taiwan.

Tagiades parra is a species of spread-winged skipper butterflies in the genus Tagiades. It is found from Sikkim and Assam to Indochina and all throughout maritime Southeast Asia. The species was first described by the German entomologist Hans Fruhstorfer in 1910 as a subspecies of Tagiades gana.
Terinos atlita is a butterfly in the family Nymphalidae. It was described by Johann Christian Fabricius in 1787. It is found in the Indomalayan realm.
Termioptycha albifurcalis is a moth in the family Pyralidae. It is found in India and Sri Lanka.
Volegalea cochlidium, common name the spiral melongena, is a species of large sea snail, a marine gastropod mollusk in the family Melongenidae, the crown conches and their allies.
Abisara kausambi, the straight plum Judy, is a small but striking butterfly found in the Indomalayan realm that belongs to the Punches and Judies, that is, the family Riodinidae.
Abisara saturata is a butterfly in the Riodinidae family. It is found in the Indomalayan realm.
Aedes vexans, the inland floodwater mosquito, is a cosmopolitan and common pest mosquito.

Agatasa is a butterfly genus in the brush-footed butterflies family (Nymphalidae). It is monotypic, containing only Agatasa calydonia, the glorious begum, which is found from southern Burma, through the Thai-Malay Peninsula, to Borneo, Sumatra and the Philippines.
Aldisa erwinkoehleri is a species of sea slugs, a dorid nudibranch, a marine gastropod mollusc in the family Cadlinidae.
Algia fasciata is a species of brush-footed butterfly found in Asia.

Antilochus coquebertii (often misspelled as coqueberti) is an Old World species of true bug in the family Pyrrhocoridae, occurring in South and Southeast Asia. It is brightly coloured, red and black, and is a beneficial predator on other pyrrhocorids, especially the genus Dysdercus, which are crop pests.

species.name: Kekep Babi
species.summary: Kekep babi (bahasa Latin: Artamus leucorynchus) adalah spesies burung dari keluarga Artamidae, dari genus Artamus. Burung ini merupakan jenis burung pemakan serangga kecil, kumbang, leba dan memiliki habitat di pesisir, sawah, kebun, tegalan, hutan sekunder. tersebar sampai ketinggian 1.500 m dpl.
Asota kageri is a moth of the family Noctuidae. It is found on Borneo and Sumatra.
Auzakia is a monotypic butterfly genus in the family Nymphalidae. It contains the single species, Auzakia danava, the commodore, which is found from Tibet to Sumatra.
Bibasis etelka, the great orange awlet, is a species of skipper described by William Chapman Hewitson in 1871.
Blasicrura pallidula, common name the little pallid cowry, is a species of sea snail, a cowry, a marine gastropod mollusk in the family Cypraeidae, the cowries.

Camponotus compressus is a species of ant found in India and Southeast Asia. It is a frequent visitor to toilets as it consumes urea. It is one of the many species which tends plant-sap-sucking insects like aphids and tree hoppers.
Celaenorrhinus asmara, the white-banded flat, is a hesperiid butterfly which is found in South and Southeast Asia.
Charaxes distanti is a butterfly in the family Nymphalidae. It was described by Eduard Honrath in 1885. It is found in the Indomalayan realm.
Chrysochroa buqueti, the red speckled jewel beetle, is a Southeast Asian species of beetle in the Buprestidae family.
Coryphellina rubrolineata is a species of sea slug, an aeolid nudibranch, a marine heterobranch mollusc in the family Flabellinidae.
Culex sitiens is an insect native to coastal areas of East Africa and Madagascar, southwestern Asia, Ryukyu Archipelago, Korea, northern Australia and South Pacific islands.

Cyclommatus elaphus is a species of the genus Cyclommatus from Indonesia. It is also the largest species of the genus Cyclommatus and can grow up to a maximum of 109 mm (4.29 inches) from the tip of the mandibles to the end of the abdomen.
Delias descombesi, the redspot Jezebel is a medium-sized butterfly of the family Pieridae, that is, the yellows and whites.

Diplonychus rusticus is an insect native in the Philippines, India, and Australia commonly known as "water bug." This insect lives in shallow waters and feed on aquatic insects including mosquito larvae.
Dophla evelina, the redspot duke, is a species of brush-footed butterfly found in South and Southeast Asia (Sri Lanka, Yunnan and India to the Philippines and Sulawesi). Many subspecies are accepted.

Dysphania subrepleta is a species of false tiger moth (genus Dysphania) in the subfamily Geometrinae. Records are from Indo-China and western Malesia including Borneo, with no subspecies listed in the Catalogue of Life, where it is a "provisionally accepted name".
Elymnias penanga, the pointed palmfly, is a butterfly in the Nymphalidae family. It was described by John Obadiah Westwood in 1851. It is found in the Indomalayan realm.
Euthalia mahadeva is a butterfly of the family Nymphalidae (Limenitidinae). It is found in the Indomalayan realm.
Fromia nodosa, commonly called elegant sea star, is a species of marine starfish belonging to the family Goniasteridae.
Glenea anticepunctata is a species of beetle in the family Cerambycidae. It was described by James Thomson in 1857. It is known from Borneo, Sumatra, India and Malaysia.

Goniobranchus roboi, common name the tooth-edged chromodoris, is a species of colourful sea slug, a dorid nudibranch, a marine gastropod mollusc in the family Chromodorididae. This species was transferred from Chromodoris to Goniobranchus in 2012.
Goniobranchus tinctorius is a species of colorful sea slug, a dorid nudibranch, a marine gastropod mollusk in the family Chromodorididae.

Graphium arycles, the spotted jay, is a species of butterfly of the family Papilionidae found in the Indomalayan ecozone. It is scarce and likely to be found in the extreme north east of India. It is not known to be threatened but the nominate subspecies is protected by law in India.

Graphium nomius, the spot swordtail, is a butterfly found in South and Southeast Asia that belongs to the swallowtail family. The species was first described by Eugenius Johann Christoph Esper in 1793. One of the grandest sights is a host of spot swordtails mud-puddling or swarming around a flowering forest tree.
Hypolycaena amabilis is a butterfly in the family Lycaenidae. It was described by Lionel de Nicéville in 1895. It is found in South-east Asia.
Jacoona anasuja is a butterfly in the family Lycaenidae. It was described by Cajetan Felder and Rudolf Felder in 1865. It is found in the Indomalayan realm.

The scarlet lily beetle, red lily beetle, or lily leaf beetle (Lilioceris lilii), is a leaf beetle that eats the leaves, stem, buds, and flower, of lilies, fritillaries and other members of the family Liliaceae. It lays its eggs most often on Lilium and Fritillaria species.
Parasarpa dudu, the white commodore, is a species of nymphalid butterfly found in tropical and subtropical Asia.
Mansonia (Mansonioides) uniformis is a species of zoophilic mosquito belonging to the genus Mansonia.
Mimathyma ambica, the Indian purple emperor, is a species of nymphalid butterfly found in Asia.

Moduza procris, the commander, sometimes included in the genus Limenitis, is a medium-sized, strikingly coloured brush-footed butterfly found in South Asia and Southeast Asia. It is notable for the mode of concealment employed by its caterpillar and the cryptic camouflage of its pupa.
Neoferdina cumingi, also known as Cuming's sea star, is a species of starfish in the family Goniasteridae. It is native to the tropical Indo-Pacific region.
Neptis nata, the clear sailer or dirty sailer, is a species of nymphalid butterfly found in South Asia.
Pseudocoladenia dan, the fulvous pied flat, is an Indomalayan butterfly belonging to the family Hesperiidae.
Psilogramma stameri is a moth of the family Sphingidae. It is known from Sumatra and Java in Indonesia.

Caplak sapi (Boophilus microplus atau Rhipicephalus microplus) adalah sejenis serangga yang menyerang sapi.Kerugian yang ditimbulkan umumnya karena menghisap darah menyebabkan anemia, merusak kulit, dermatitis.Namun perananya yang lebih penting adalah sebagai vektor penyakit piroplasmosis, anaplasmosis dan theileriosis…
Risoba diversipennis is a species of tuft moth native to the Himalayas, Indochina and to Papua New Guinea. It was described by Francis Walker in 1858. Recorded host plants are Melastoma.
Thestus alexandra is a species of beetle in the family Cerambycidae. It was described by James Thomson in 1878. It is known from Sumatra and Malaysia.
Thorunna africana is a small species of sea slug, a dorid nudibranch, a shell-less marine gastropod mollusk in the family Chromodorididae.

Thuridilla moebii is a species of sacoglossan sea slug, a shell-less marine opisthobranch gastropod mollusc in the family Plakobranchidae. It is found in shallow water in the tropical west and central Indo-Pacific region.
Tomara tigrinella is a species of moth, found on Borneo. It is the only species in the genus Tomara, and belongs to the family Tineidae.

Xenocatantops humilis is the type species of grasshoppers in its genus of the family Acrididae and subfamily Catantopinae. This species can be found in India, Indo-China, Malesia (the type locality is Java), and Papua New Guinea.
